content:
maria: Heads up — Okta SAML IdP cert for redwood-prod expires in 7 days (2026-03-30). This will break SSO for some services if not rotated. We need an urgent cert rotation + metadata push. Please ack if you own any SSO integrations and can verify metadata endpoints.

samir: Ack. Which services are pinned to the old cert (thumbprint/static metadata)?

maria: Short list from the discovery scan below. Plan: gather owners, rotate IdP cert in a maintenance window, push new metadata, and have owners validate logins. We're planning canary on non-prod first. Sign-up sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rw-idp-rotation-signup

anita-bot: Automated scan found 3 integrations with pinned thumbprint: k8s-api-prod, grafana-prod, legacy-jenkins-prod. See details in internal doc https://redwood.infra/docs/idp-rotation

devon: I own k8s-api-prod. I can try updating cluster SSO config today EOD, will test in staging first.

lee: I can take Grafana. Need the new idp metadata file and the time window to avoid interrupting dashboards for customers.

jess: I'll coordinate with infra oncall and schedule the maintenance window. Recommend doing it 02:00-04:00 UTC to minimize impact.

oncall-bot: Maintenance window booked: 2026-03-29 02:00-04:00 UTC (infra-oncall).

maria: Proposed timeline:
- 2026-03-28: prepare metadata & certs, owners confirm readiness
- 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC: rotate in non-prod / canary
- 2026-03-29 03:00 UTC: rotate in prod if canary OK
- Post-rotate: owners post status to this thread

samir: Commands to pull metadata and push (example):
```bash
# fetch idp metadata from Okta
curl -o idp.xml "https://okta.example.com/app/redwood/sso/saml/metadata"
# upload to k8s as secret (example for cluster owners)
kubectl -n kube-system create secret generic idp-metadata --from-file=idp.xml --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```

maria: If your integration uses pinned cert thumbprints (legacy Jenkins), you need to update the thumbprint in the service config to the new cert. If you rely on metadata URL, pulling the new metadata should be sufficient.

devon: Staging update: k8s-api-staging accepted new metadata — SSO login ok. Will attempt prod during the window.

lee: Grafana staging: updated and validated. dashboards still available.

maria: After rotation, please post EXACT status lines like: `owner: service - status: success/fail - notes`

lee: owner: grafana-prod - status: success - notes: metadata refreshed, users can login, no errors.

devon: owner: k8s-api-prod - status: fail - notes: kube-apiserver rejects assertion due to signature mismatch. Investigating.

jess: Filed RW-1234 for the kube-apiserver assertion issue, assigning to devon.

anita-bot: Metadata signature algorithm: sha256WithRSAEncryption. No unexpected algorithm changes detected.

maria: @devon if you hit signature mismatch, please paste the assertion log lines (redact PII) and try re-fetching metadata and restarting control-plane pods as needed. If still failing, escalate to PKI.

devon: owner: k8s-api-prod - status: success - notes: fixed config (had old cached metadata in secret); restarted apiserver, SSO validated.

maria: Thanks — great quick turnaround. Final checklist: all owners must confirm success in this thread before we close. If you haven't signed up yet, please add yourself: https://tinyurl.com/rw-idp-rotation-signup

maria: Follow-up: I'll open a short postmortem if we see incidents; also adding an action item to remove thumbprint pinning for legacy integrations where possible. :thumbsup:
